summary.text: Liz Hallock is the No Kings Party candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 15-Position 2, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces Republican Reedy Berg.
An attorney and small business owner, she has run for office in Washington several times since 2018.

paragraphs.text: Liz Hallock earned a bachelor's degree from Princeton University in 2002 and a law degree from the University of San Francisco School of Law, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as a small business owner and entrepreneur and as an attorney.
Hallock ran for the Washington House in District 14-Position 2 in 2018 as a Democrat, losing the general election to incumbent Gina Mosbrucker with 39.0 percent of the vote.
She ran for the same seat in 2022 as an independent and received 32.8 percent in the general election.
In 2024 she was a Democratic candidate in Washington's 7th Congressional District and did not advance from the August 6 primary, receiving 7.6 percent.
In the August 4, 2026 primary for District 15-Position 2, she finished second with 30.1 percent of the vote, behind Berg, who received 48.6 percent.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Hallock described herself as a small business owner, attorney, mother of two and essential worker.
Her listed campaign messages were healthcare for all, making Amazon a public utility, and strengthening domestic violence and child abuse prevention and reporting.
